verses.geez:
ወአርዌ ፡ ምድርሰ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ትጠብብ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወትቤላ
                  ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለብእሲት ፡ ምንትኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘይቤለክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢትብልዑ ፡ እምዕፅ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ገነት ።
verses.translation: Now the serpent was the most crafty of all the brutes on the earth, which the Lord God made, and the serpent said to the woman, Wherefore has God said, Eat not of every tree of the garden?

translations.lxx: Now the serpent was the most crafty of all the brutes on the earth, which the Lord God made, and the serpent said to the woman, Wherefore has God said, Eat not of every tree of the garden?
translations.kjv: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
translations.ron: Şarpele însă era cel mai şiret dintre toate fiarele de pe pământ, pe care le făcuse Domnul Dumnezeu. Şi a zis şarpele către femeie: "Dumnezeu a zis El, oare, să nu mâncaţi roade din orice pom din rai?"
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ ὄφις ἦν φρονιμώτατος πάντων τῶν θηρίων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ὧν ἐποίησε Κύριος ὁ Θεός· καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ὄφις τῇ γυναικὶ, τί ὅτι εἶπεν ὁ Θεός, οὐ μὴ φάγητε ἀπὸ παντὸς ξύλου τοῦ παραδείσου;

verses.geez: ወትቤላ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ ለአርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ እምነ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ዘይፈሪ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገነት ፡ ንበልዕ ።
verses.translation: And the woman said to the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden,

translations.lxx: And the woman said to the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden,
translations.kjv: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
translations.ron: Iar femeia a zis către şarpe: "Roade din pomii raiului putem să mâncăm;
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ τῷ ὄφει, ἀπὸ καρποῦ τοῦ ξύλου τοῦ παραδείσου φαγούμεθα·

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ [ፍሬ ፡] ዕፅሰ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ ዘሀሎ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ገነት ፡ ይቤለነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንብላዕ ፡ እምኔሁ
                  ፡ ወከመ ፡ ኢንግስሶ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንሙት ፡ ይቤ ።
verses.translation: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

translations.lxx: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
translations.kjv: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
translations.ron: Numai din rodul pomului celui din mijlocul raiului ne-a zis Dumnezeu: "Să nu mâncaţi din el, nici să vă atingeţi de el, ca să nu muriţi!"
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ καρποῦ τοῦ ξύλου, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ παραδείσου, εἶπεν ὁ Θεός, οὐ φάγεσθε ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, οὐδὲ μὴ ἅψησθε αὐτοῦ, ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνητε.

verses.geez: ወትቤላ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለብእሲት ፡ አኮ ፡ ሞተ ፡ ዘትመውቱ ።
verses.translation: And the serpent said to the woman, Ye shall not surely die.

translations.lxx: And the serpent said to the woman, Ye shall not surely die.
translations.kjv: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
translations.ron: Atunci şarpele a zis către femeie: "Nu, nu veţi muri!
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ὄφις τῇ γυναικί· οὐ θανάτῳ ἀποθανεῖσθε·

verses.geez:
አላ ፡ እስመ ፡ ያአምር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ትበልዑ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ይትፈታሕ ፡ አዕይንቲክሙ ፡
                  [ወትከውኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ አማልክት ፡] ወታአምሩ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ወእኩየ ።
verses.translation: For God knew that in whatever day ye should eat of it your eyes would be opened, and ye would be as gods, knowing good and evil.

translations.lxx: For God knew that in whatever day ye should eat of it your eyes would be opened, and ye would be as gods, knowing good and evil.
translations.kjv: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
translations.ron: Dar Dumnezeu ştie că în ziua în care veţi mânca din el vi se vor deschide ochii şi veţi fi ca Dumnezeu, cunoscând binele şi răul".
translations.grk: Ἤδει γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς, ὅτι ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ φάγητε ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, διανοιχθήσονται ὑμῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί, καὶ ἔσεσθε ὡς θεοί, γινώσκοντες καλὸν καὶ πονηρόν.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእየት ፡ ብእሲት ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ለበሊዕ ፡ ወሠናይ ፡ ለአዕይንት ፡ ወለርእይ ፡ ወሠናየ ፡ ያጤይቅ
                  ፡ ነሥአት ፡ ፍሬሁ ፡ ወበልዐት ፡ ወወሀበቶ ፡ ለብእሲሃ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወበልዑ ።
verses.translation: And the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes to look upon and beautiful to contemplate, and having taken of its fruit she ate, and she gave to her husband also with her, and they ate.

translations.lxx: And the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes to look upon and beautiful to contemplate, and having taken of its fruit she ate, and she gave to her husband also with her, and they ate.
translations.kjv: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
translations.ron: De aceea femeia, socotind că rodul pomului este bun de mâncat şi plăcut ochilor la vedere şi vrednic de dorit, pentru că dă ştiinţă, a luat din el şi a mâncat şi a dat bărbatului său şi a mâncat şi el.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδεν ἡ γυνὴ, ὅτι καλὸν τὸ ξύλον εἰς βρῶσιν, καὶ ὅτι ἀρεστὸν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ἰδεῖν, καὶ ὡραῖόν ἐστι τοῦ κατανοῆσαι· καὶ λαβοῦσα ἀπὸ τοῦ καρποῦ αὐτοῦ, ἔφαγε· καὶ ἔδωκε καὶ τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς μετʼ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἔφαγον.

verses.geez:
ወተፈትሐ ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ ፡ [ለክልኤሆሙ ፡] ወአእመሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዕራቃኒሆሙ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ወሰፈዩ ፡ ቈጽለ ፡ በለስ ፡
                  ወገብሩ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ መዋርእተ ።
verses.translation: And the eyes of both were opened, and they perceived that they were naked, and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons to go round them.

translations.lxx: And the eyes of both were opened, and they perceived that they were naked, and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons to go round them.
translations.kjv: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
translations.ron: Atunci li s-au deschis ochii la amândoi şi au cunoscut că erau goi, şi au cusut frunze de smochin şi şi-au făcut acoperăminte.
translations.grk: Καὶ διηνοίχθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ τῶν δύο, καὶ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι γυμνοὶ ἦσαν· καὶ ἔῤῥαψαν φύλλα συκῆς, καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς περιζώματα.

verses.geez:
ወሰምዑ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እንዘ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገነት ፡ ፍና ፡ ሰርክ ፡ ወተኀብኡ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡
                  እምቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ዕፀዊሃ ፡ ለገነት ።
verses.translation: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the afternoon; and both Adam and his wife hid themselves from the face of the Lord God in the midst of the trees of the garden.

translations.lxx: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the afternoon; and both Adam and his wife hid themselves from the face of the Lord God in the midst of the trees of the garden.
translations.kjv: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
translations.ron: Iar când au auzit glasul Domnului Dumnezeu, Care umbla prin rai, în răcoarea serii, s-au ascuns Adam şi femeia lui de faţa Domnului Dumnezeu printre pomii raiului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤκουσαν τὴς φωνὴς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ περιπατοῦντος ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ τὸ δειλινόν· καὶ ἐκρύβησαν ὅ, τε Ἀδὰμ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ ξύλου τοῦ παραδείσου.

verses.geez: ወጸውዖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አይቴ ፡ አንተ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord God called Adam and said to him, Adam, where art thou?

translations.lxx: And the Lord God called Adam and said to him, Adam, where art thou?
translations.kjv: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
translations.ron: Şi a strigat Domnul Dumnezeu pe Adam şi i-a zis: "Adame, unde eşti?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Ἀδὰμ, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἀδὰμ ποῦ εἶ;

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ አዳም ፡ ቃለከ ፡ ሰማዕኩ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ታንሶሱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገነት ፡ ወፈራህኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዕራቅየ ፡ አነ ፡
                  ወተኀባእኩ ።
verses.translation: And he said to him, I heard thy voice as thou walkedst in the garden, and I feared because I was naked and I hid myself.

translations.lxx: And he said to him, I heard thy voice as thou walkedst in the garden, and I feared because I was naked and I hid myself.
translations.kjv: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
translations.ron: Răspuns-a acesta: "Am auzit glasul Tău în rai şi m-am temut, căci sunt gol, şi m-am ascuns".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· τὴς φωνῆς σου ἤκουσα περιπατοῦντος ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ, καὶ ἐφοβήθην ὅτι γυμνός εἰμι, καὶ ἐκρύβην.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መኑ ፡ አይድዐከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዕራቅከ ፡ አንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ አኮ ፡ ዘበላዕከ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ዕፀ ፡
                  ዘአነ ፡ ከላእኩከ ።
verses.translation: And God said to him, Who told thee that thou wast naked, unless thou hast eaten of the tree concerning which I charged thee of it alone not to eat?

translations.lxx: And God said to him, Who told thee that thou wast naked, unless thou hast eaten of the tree concerning which I charged thee of it alone not to eat?
translations.kjv: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
translations.ron: Şi i-a zis Dumnezeu: "Cine ti-a spus că eşti gol? Nu cumva ai mâncat din pomul din care ti-am poruncit să nu mănânci?"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Θεὸς, τὶς ἀνήγγειλέ σοι ὅτι γυμνὸς εἶ, εἰ μὴ ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου, οὗ ἐνετειλάμην σοι τούτου μόνου μὴ φαγεῖν, ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἔφαγες;

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ አዳም ፡ ብእሲትየ ፡ እንተ ፡ ወሀብከኒ ፡ ምስሌየ ፡ ትንበር ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወሀበተኒ ፡ ወበላዕኩ ።
verses.translation: And Adam said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me—she gave me of the tree and I ate.

translations.lxx: And Adam said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me—she gave me of the tree and I ate.
translations.kjv: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
translations.ron: Zis-a Adam: "Femeia care mi-ai dat-o să fie cu mine, aceea mi-a dat din pom şi am mâncat".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἀδάμ· ἡ γυνή, ἣν ἔδωκας μετʼ ἐμοῦ, αὕτη μοι ἔδωκεν ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου, καὶ ἔφαγον.

verses.geez:
ወይቤላ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለብእሲት ፡ ዘንተኑ ፡ ገበርኪ ፡ ወትቤ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ አስፈጠተኒ ፡ ወበላዕኩ
                  ።
verses.translation: And the Lord God said to the woman, Why hast thou done this? And the woman said, The serpent deceived me and I ate.

translations.lxx: And the Lord God said to the woman, Why hast thou done this? And the woman said, The serpent deceived me and I ate.
translations.kjv: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul Dumnezeu către femeie: "Pentru ce ai făcut aceasta?" Iar femeia a zis: "Şarpele m-a amăgit şi eu am mâncat".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τῇ γυναικί· τί τοῦτο ἐποιήσας; καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ, ὁ ὄφις ἠπάτησέ με, καὶ ἔφαγον.

verses.geez:
ወይቤላ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ እስመ ፡ ገበርክዮ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ርግምተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ እንስሳ ፡
                  ወእምኵሉ ፡ አራዊተ ፡ ምድር ፡ በእንግድዓኪ ፡ ሑሪ ፡ ወመሬተ ፡ ብልዒ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕይወትኪ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord God said to the serpent, Because thou hast done this thou art cursed above all cattle and all the brutes of the earth, on thy breast and belly thou shalt go, and thou shalt eat earth all the days of thy life.

translations.lxx: And the Lord God said to the serpent, Because thou hast done this thou art cursed above all cattle and all the brutes of the earth, on thy breast and belly thou shalt go, and thou shalt eat earth all the days of thy life.
translations.kjv: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul Dumnezeu către şarpe: "Pentru că ai făcut aceasta, blestemat să fii între toate animalele şi între toate fiarele câmpului; pe pântecele tău să te târăşti şi ţărână să mănânci în toate zilele vieţii tale!
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τῷ ὄφει· ὅτι ἐποίησας τοῦτο, ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν, καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν θηρίων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· ἐπὶ τῷ στήθει σου καὶ τῇ κοιλίᾳ πορεύσῃ, καὶ γῆν φαγῃ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου.

verses.geez:
አስተፃርር ፡ ማእከሌኪ ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ዘርእኪ ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ዘርኣ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለይዕቀብ ፡ ርእሰኪ
                  ፡ ወአንቲ ፡ ዕቀቢ ፡ ሰኰናሁ ።
verses.translation: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman and between thy seed and her seed, he shall watch against thy head, and thou shalt watch against his heel.

translations.lxx: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman and between thy seed and her seed, he shall watch against thy head, and thou shalt watch against his heel.
translations.kjv: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
translations.ron: Duşmănie voi pune între tine şi între femeie, între sămânţa ta şi sămânţa ei; aceasta îţi va zdrobi capul, iar tu îi vei înţepa călcâiul".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔχθραν θήσω ἀνὰ μέσον σοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς γυναικὸς, καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σπέρματός σου, καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτῆς· αὐτός σοῦ τηρήσει κεφαλὴν, καὶ σὺ τηρήσεις αὐτοῦ πτέρναν.

verses.geez:
ወለብእሲትኒ ፡ ይቤላ ፡ አብዝኆ ፡ አበዝኆ ፡ ለሐዘንኪ ፡ ወለሥቃይኬ ፡ ወበሐዘን ፡ ለዲ ፡ ወወሊደኪ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምትኪ ፡
                  ምግባኢኪ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ይቀንየኪ ።
verses.translation: And to the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy pains and thy groanings; in pain thou shalt bring forth children, and thy submission shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

translations.lxx: And to the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy pains and thy groanings; in pain thou shalt bring forth children, and thy submission shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
translations.kjv: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
translations.ron: Iar femeii i-a zis: "Voi înmulţi mereu necazurile tale, mai ales în vremea sarcinii tale; în dureri vei naşte copii; atrasă vei fi către bărbatul tău şi el te va stăpâni".
translations.grk: Καὶ τῇ γυναικὶ εἶπε· πληθύνων πληθυνῶ τὰς λύπας σου, καὶ τὸν στεναγμόν σου· ἐν λύπαις τέξῃ τέκνα, καὶ πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα σου ἡ ἀποστροφή σου· καὶ αὐτός σου κυριεύσει.

verses.geez:
ወለአዳምሰ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰማዕከ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ብእሲትከ ፡ ወበላዕከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ዘአዘዝኩከ ፡ ከመ ፡
                  ኢትብላዕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ባሕቲቱ ፡ ወበላዕከ ፡ ርግምተ ፡ ትኩን ፡ ምድር ፡ በተግባርከ ፡ ወበሐዘን ፡ ብላዕ ፡
                  ኵሎ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕይወትከ ።
verses.translation: And to Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened to the voice of thy wife, and eaten of the tree concerning which I charged thee of it only not to eat—of that thou hast eaten, cursed is the ground in thy labours, in pain shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life.

translations.lxx: And to Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened to the voice of thy wife, and eaten of the tree concerning which I charged thee of it only not to eat—of that thou hast eaten, cursed is the ground in thy labours, in pain shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life.
translations.kjv: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
translations.ron: Iar lui Adam i-a zis: "Pentru că ai ascultat vorba femeii tale şi ai mâncat din pomul din care ţi-am poruncit: "Să nu mănânci", blestemat va fi pământul pentru tine! Cu osteneală să te hrăneşti din el în toate zilele vieţii tale!
translations.grk: Τῷ δὲ Ἀδὰμ εἶπεν· ὅτι ἤκουσας τῆς φωνῆς τῆς γυναικός σου, καὶ ἔφαγες ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου, οὗ ἐνετειλάμην σοι τούτου μόνου μὴ φαγεῖν, ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἔφαγες, ἐπικατάρατος ἡ γῆ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις σου· ἐν λύπαις φάγῃ αὐτὴν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου.

verses.geez: አሥዋክ ፡ ወአሜከላ ፡ ይብቈልከ ፡ ወብላዕ ፡ ሣዕረ ፡ ገዳም ።
verses.translation: Thorns and thistles shall it bring forth to thee, and thou shalt eat the herb of the field.

translations.lxx: Thorns and thistles shall it bring forth to thee, and thou shalt eat the herb of the field.
translations.kjv: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
translations.ron: Spini şi pălămidă îţi va rodi el şi te vei hrăni cu iarba câmpului!
translations.grk: Ἀκάνθας καὶ τριβόλους ἀνατελεῖ σοι, καὶ φαγῇ τὸν χόρτον τοῦ ἀγροῦ.

verses.geez:
ወበሃፈ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ ብላዕ ፡ ኅብስተከ ፡ [እስከ ፡] ትገብእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሬትከ ፡ እንተ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ወፃእከ ፡ እስመ
                  ፡ መሬት ፡ አንተ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ መሬት ፡ ትገብእ ።
verses.translation: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat thy bread until thou return to the earth out of which thou wast taken, for earth thou art and to earth thou shalt return.

translations.lxx: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat thy bread until thou return to the earth out of which thou wast taken, for earth thou art and to earth thou shalt return.
translations.kjv: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
translations.ron: În sudoarea fetei tale îţi vei mânca pâinea ta, până te vei întoarce în pământul din care eşti luat; căci pământ eşti şi în pământ te vei întoarce".
translations.grk: Ἐν ἱδρῶτι τοῦ προσώπου σου φαγῃ τὸν ἄρτον σου, ἕως τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι σε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐξ ἧς ἐλήμφθης· ὅτι γῆ εἶ, καὶ εἰς γῆν ἀπελεύσῃ.

verses.geez: ወሰመያ ፡ አዳም ፡ ስመ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ እስመ ፡ እሞሙ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ለሕያዋን ።
verses.translation: And Adam called the name of his wife Life, because she was the mother of all living.

translations.lxx: And Adam called the name of his wife Life, because she was the mother of all living.
translations.kjv: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
translations.ron: Şi a pus Adam femeii sale numele Eva, adică viaţă, pentru că ea era să fie mama tuturor celor vii.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ἀδὰμ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ Ζωή, ὅτι μήτηρ πάντων τῶν ζώντων.

verses.geez: ወገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ወለብእሲቱ ፡ አዕዳለ ፡ ዘማእስ ፡ ወአልበሶሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord God made for Adam and his wife garments of skin, and clothed them.

translations.lxx: And the Lord God made for Adam and his wife garments of skin, and clothed them.
translations.kjv: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
translations.ron: Apoi a făcut Domnul Dumnezeu lui Adam şi femeii lui îmbrăcăminte de piele şi i-a îmbrăcat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τῷ Ἀδὰμ, καὶ τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ χιτῶνας δερματίνους, καὶ ἐνέδυσεν αὐτούς.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ናሁ ፡ አዳም ፡ ኮነ ፡ ከመ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ያአምር ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ወእኩየ ፡ ወይእዜኒ ፡
                  ዮጊ ፡ ያአምር ፡ ወያሌዕል ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወይነሥእ ፡ እምዕፀ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ ወይበልዕ ፡ ወየሐዩ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.translation: And God said, Behold, Adam is become as one of us, to know good and evil, and now lest at any time he stretch forth his hand, and take of the tree of life and eat, and so he shall live for ever—

translations.lxx: And God said, Behold, Adam is become as one of us, to know good and evil, and now lest at any time he stretch forth his hand, and take of the tree of life and eat, and so he shall live for ever—
translations.kjv: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul Dumnezeu: "Iată Adam s-a făcut ca unul dintre Noi, cunoscând binele şi răul. Şi acum nu cumva să-şi întindă mâna şi să ia roade din pomul vieţii, să mănânce şi să trăiască în veci!..."
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Θεός, ἰδοὺ Ἀδὰμ γέγονεν ὡς εἷς ἐξ ἡμῶν, τοῦ γινώσκειν καλὸν καὶ πονηρόν· καὶ νῦν μή ποτε ἐκτείνῃ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ λάβῃ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ φάγῃ, καὶ ζήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.geez:
ወአውፅኦ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአዳም ፡ እምነ ፡ ገነተ ፡ ትድላ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትገበራ ፡ ለምድር ፡ እንተ ፡
                  እምኔሃ ፡ ወፅአ ።
verses.translation: So the Lord God sent him forth out of the garden of Delight to cultivate the ground out of which he was taken.

translations.lxx: So the Lord God sent him forth out of the garden of Delight to cultivate the ground out of which he was taken.
translations.kjv: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
translations.ron: De aceea l-a scos Domnul Dumnezeu din grădina cea din Eden, ca să lucreze pământul, din care fusese luat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτὸν Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τοῦ παραδείσου τῆς τρυφῆς, ἐργάζεσθαι τὴν γῆν ἐξ ἧς ἐλήμφθη.

verses.geez:
ወአውጽኦ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ወአኅደሮ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገነተ ፡ ትፍሥሕት ፡ ወአዘዞሙ ፡ ለ(ሱራፌል ፡ ወለ)ኪሩቤል ፡ በሰይፈ ፡
                  እሳት ፡ እንተ ፡ ትትመየጥ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይዕቀቡ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ ሕይወት ።
verses.translation: And he cast out Adam and caused him to dwell over against the garden of Delight, and stationed the cherubs and the fiery sword that turns about to keep the way of the tree of life.

translations.lxx: And he cast out Adam and caused him to dwell over against the garden of Delight, and stationed the cherubs and the fiery sword that turns about to keep the way of the tree of life.
translations.kjv: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
translations.ron: Şi izgonind pe Adam, l-a aşezat în preajma grădinii celei din Eden şi a pus heruvimi şi sabie de flacără vâlvâitoare, să păzească drumul către pomul vieţii.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὸν Ἀδὰμ, καὶ κατῴκισεν αὐτὸν ἀπέναντι τοῦ παραδείσου τῆς τρυφῆς· καὶ ἔταξε τὰ χερουβὶμ· καὶ τὴν φλογίνην ῥομφαίαν τὴν στρεφομένην, φυλάσσειν τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς.
